evidence: Reads a 32-bit member at input+0x10; when nonzero it tail-calls the accepted openssl_evp_cipher_update helper, and when zero it tail-calls f_700159c900. Caller passes cipher-context-like arguments and tests the returned status. This describes the observed branch without guessing the unnamed handler’s role. decompiled/main/main_0154.c:6726-6734; caller decompiled/main/main_0155.c:12859-12863.

Calls the global asset-binder pointer availability helper with an output slot; only when it reports an existing pointer does this function call the accepted initialize_asset_binder_font_texture_pools helper with the two saved input arguments. Its caller passes asset/path-like arguments from a stadium/resource initialization flow. decompiled/main/main_0063.c:35397-35419; caller decompiled/main/main_0063.c:51404-51410.

Queries context selector 0x24 and returns 1 if that value is nonzero; only otherwise queries selector 0x26 and returns whether it is nonzero. Its caller branches directly on the boolean result. decompiled/main/main_0054.c:54187-54205; caller decompiled/main/main_0054.c:53369-53371.

Queries selector 0x13, returns 0 unless its low byte is 5, and on that path queries selector 0x25 and returns true exactly when that value is zero. Caller uses the result as a boolean predicate. decompiled/main/main_0081.c:45481-45501; caller decompiled/main/main_0081.c:41381-41384.

Calls dispatch_context_event_state with x1=0, then tail-calls another helper with the same pointer and zero argument. The direct caller supplies a global address, but the follow-up helper’s semantic role is not recovered, so no useful high-level name is supported. decompiled/main/main_0166.c:51266-51280; caller decompiled/main/main_0120.c:17860-17863.
